name: Driving Simulator Medina
summary:
The dream drive, from the driver's seat - around Al Madinah.

THE CAR
A V12 sports car with a race cockpit: racing wheel, bucket seats, roll cage, shift lights and a live display. Reach out with your own hands - grip the wheel, work the gear stick, pull the handbrake - or drive with the joysticks.

A REAL 6-SPEED MANUAL
Move the stick through a real H-pattern, rev it to the shift lights and snap the next gear in. Prefer to cruise? Switch to automatic.

68 KM OF THE 3RD RING ROAD
The whole ring road around A
